description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing dynamic menus in the SuiteCRM interface, including functions for showing, hiding, positioning menus, handling browser compatibility, and managing menu stacks.

methods.name: eraseTimeout
methods.description: Clears a timeout given its ID and returns null.

methods.name: tbButtonMouseOverOrig
methods.description: Handles mouse over event on a toolbar button, closes other menus, and shows the associated menu.

methods.name: tbButtonMouseOver
methods.description: Sets a delayed action to show a menu when mouse hovers over a toolbar button.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays a menu at specified position, closing others if necessary.

methods.name: showSubMenu
methods.description: Displays a submenu relative to its parent menu.

methods.name: popupMenu
methods.description: Positions and makes a menu visible, adjusting for browser width.

methods.name: popupSubMenu
methods.description: Positions and shows a submenu relative to its parent menu.

methods.name: closeMenusOrig
methods.description: Closes the current menu.

methods.name: closeSubMenus
methods.description: Closes submenus related to a handle.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: Hides a specific menu.

methods.name: closeMenus
methods.description: Sets a timeout to close all menus.

methods.name: closeAllMenus
methods.description: Closes all open menus immediately.

methods.name: setMenuVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility and position of a menu, handling submenus and browser adjustments.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID.

methods.name: setMenuVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a menu element, adjusting styles and handling browser quirks.

methods.name: menuPop
methods.description: Pops a menu from the menu stack, with special handling for IE on Mac.

methods.name: menuPush
methods.description: Pushes a menu onto the menu stack, with special handling for IE on Mac.

methods.name: checkBrowserWidth
methods.description: Checks window width and shows/hides sidebar accordingly.

methods.name: showSB
methods.description: Shows or hides sidebar elements based on parameters.

methods.name: setLayer
methods.description: Sets position and visibility of a DOM element by ID.

methods.name: setLayerElm
methods.description: Applies style changes to a DOM element for visibility and position.

methods.name: hiliteItem
methods.description: Highlights a menu item on hover.

methods.name: unhiliteItem
methods.description: Removes highlight from a menu item.

methods.name: showElement
methods.description: Makes all elements of a given tag visible.

methods.name: showElementNew
methods.description: Restores visibility of elements stored in hiddenElmStack.

methods.name: hideElement
methods.description: Hides elements overlapping a specified rectangle area.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Browser detection class with properties for different browsers and versions.

methods.name: runPageLoadItems
methods.description: Initializes page load actions, such as checking browser width.
